CustomObject.description: FIX-20178 / US-20194: exceptions to a PMT team's default owner. For a team, the first rule (DeveloperName order) whose Condition is true sets the owner; an empty Condition always applies; no applicable rule = the team's default owner (PMTTeam__mdt). Conditions read ProjectProduct__c fields only. Read through the PMTMatrix Apex class.
CustomObject.label: PMT - Owner Rule
